subject: [PATCH v8 30/30] selftests/mm: add PMD swap entry tests

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch adds tests for PMD (Page Map Directory) swap entry functionality in the Linux kernel. The tests cover various scenarios, including swapping out a THP (Transparent Huge Page) and verifying that the thp_swpout_pmd counter is increased accordingly. The patch also includes code to read /proc/vmstat fields and register the pmd_swap test with the default runner. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous swap devices and handles cases where zswap is enabled. The tests are designed to be skipped if the kernel does not implement PMD swap entries or if it lacks a thp_swpout_pmd counter.

2026-10-07.patch_summary: This patch adds tests for PMD (Page Map Directory) swap entries to the Linux kernel's selftest suite. The tests verify that PMD-mapped huge pages are correctly swapped out and in, including edge cases such as asynchronous devices and zswap enabled systems. The patch also includes a new /proc/vmstat field reader and registers the pmd_swap test with the default runner. The tests cover various scenarios, including fork, write, munmap, mprotect, and swapoff, to ensure that PMD swap entries are handled correctly.
